name: query_sql_from_plan
description: Execute a SQL query from a structured QueryPlan. Normalizes low-cardinality filter values using embeddings (e.g., 'UK' -> 'United Kingdom'), applies RBAC filters, and generates safe parameterized SQL.

plan.description: QueryPlan object with tables, select_fields, filters, joins, group_by, order_by, and limit

return_type.description: Query results with data rows, generated SQL, and metadata

examples.description: Execute query plan with value normalization for 'UK'

safety_guidelines: Enforce row limits to prevent large result sets
